shortDescription: Manage images of OpenStack image (Glance) service.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: How long should the socket layer wait before timing out for API calls. If this is omitted, nothing will be passed to the requests library.

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary containing auth information as needed by the cloud's auth plugin strategy. For the default I(password) plugin, this would contain I(auth_url), I(username), I(password), I(project_name) and any information about domains (for example, I(user_domain_name) or I(project_domain_name)) if the cloud supports them. For other plugins, this param will need to contain whatever parameters that auth plugin requires. This parameter is not needed if a named cloud is provided or OpenStack OS_* environ

options.name: auth_type
options.description: Name of the auth plugin to use. If the cloud uses something other than password authentication, the name of the plugin should be indicated here and the contents of the I(auth) parameter should be updated accordingly.

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: A path to a CA Cert bundle that can be used as part of verifying SSL API requests.

options.name: checksum
options.description: The checksum of the image.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: A path to a client certificate to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: client_key
options.description: A path to a client key to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: cloud
options.description: Named cloud or cloud config to operate against. If I(cloud) is a string, it references a named cloud config as defined in an OpenStack clouds.yaml file. Provides default values for I(auth) and I(auth_type). This parameter is not needed if I(auth) is provided or if OpenStack OS_* environment variables are present. If I(cloud) is a dict, it contains a complete cloud configuration like would be in a section of clouds.yaml.

options.name: container_format
options.description: The format of the container. This image attribute cannot be changed. Examples are C(ami), C(aki), C(ari), C(bare), C(ovf), C(ova) or C(docker).

options.name: disk_format
options.description: The format of the disk that is getting uploaded. This image attribute cannot be changed. Examples are C(ami), C(ari), C(aki), C(vhd), C(vmdk), C(raw), C(qcow2), C(vdi), c(iso), C(vhdx) or C(ploop).

options.name: filename
options.description: The path to the file which has to be uploaded. This image attribute cannot be changed.

options.name: id
options.description: The ID of the image when uploading an image. This image attribute cannot be changed.

options.name: import_method
options.description: Method to use for importing the image. Not all deployments support all methods. Supports web-download or glance-download. copy-image is not supported with create actions. glance-direct is removed from the import method so use_import can be used in that case.

options.name: interface
options.description: Endpoint URL type to fetch from the service catalog.

options.name: is_protected
options.description: Prevent image from being deleted.

options.name: is_public
options.description: Whether the image can be accessed publicly. Setting I(is_public) to C(true) requires admin role by default. I(is_public) has been deprecated. Use I(visibility) instead of I(is_public).

options.name: kernel
options.description: The name of an existing kernel image that will be associated with this image.

options.name: min_disk
options.description: The minimum disk space (in GB) required to boot this image.

options.name: min_ram
options.description: The minimum ram (in MB) required to boot this image.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the image when uploading - or the name/ID of the image if deleting. If provided with the id, it can be used to change the name of existing image.

options.name: owner
options.description: The name or ID of the project owning the image.

options.name: owner_domain
options.description: The name or id of the domain the project owning the image belongs to. May be used to identify a unique project when providing a name to the project argument and multiple projects with such name exist.

options.name: properties
options.description: Additional properties to be associated with this image.

options.name: ramdisk
options.description: The name of an existing ramdisk image that will be associated with this image.

options.name: region_name
options.description: Name of the region.

options.name: sdk_log_level
options.description: Log level of the OpenStackSDK

options.name: sdk_log_path
options.description: Path to the logfile of the OpenStackSDK. If empty no log is written

options.name: state
options.description: Should the resource be present, absent or inactive.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags to be applied to the image.

options.name: timeout
options.description: How long should ansible wait for the requested resource.

options.name: uri
options.description: Required only if using the web-download import method. This url is where the data is made available to the Image service.

options.name: use_import
options.description: Use the 'glance-direct' method of the interoperable image import mechanism. Should only be used when needed, such as when the user needs the cloud to transform image format.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not SSL API requests should be verified. Before Ansible 2.3 this defaulted to C(true).

options.name: visibility
options.description: The image visibility.

options.name: volume
options.description: ID of a volume to create an image from. The volume must be in AVAILABLE state. I(volume) has been deprecated. Use module M(openstack.cloud.volume) instead.

options.name: wait
options.description: Should ansible wait until the requested resource is complete.
